_about: The ragas the songs in songs.json are in, for the backdrop a song loads (a quiet background in the song's scale on the side seats; the centre stays silent for his hand). Swars as in notation.js: S r R g G m M P d D n N (lower case komal, M tivra), ' an octave up, , down. aroha / avaroha / pakad are the common textbook forms (one of several in use); vadi / samvadi as usually taught. 'first' is the tanpura's first string. Marked 'approx' where a raga is a mix or its forms differ a lot.
